projectDescription: AI Surfer is a full-stack AI marketing agency platform that combines AI-powered sales agents, wave audits, lead capture, launch planning, and member dashboards to help businesses automate growth and marketing operations.
keyFeatures: AI Wave Audit — scored 5-question questionnaire that identifies AI automation opportunities across sales, operations, content, and support
Wave Check — free 3-question AI readiness quiz with email-captured action plan
Launch Desk — OpenAI-powered agent (gpt-5.6-terra) that turns launch briefs into structured release plans with readiness scoring
AI Fin Lead Pipeline — Express API endpoints for capturing, auditing, handing off, following up, and onboarding leads via Supabase
Members Dashboard — subscription-gated portal with AI product suite (Wave Scout, Sales Rider, Content Creator, Customer Care Cove, Automation Architect, Big Kahuna)
AI Agent Skills — Sales Agent, Customer Support Agent, and Review Booster Agent SKILL definitions for pluggable AI workflows
Stripe integration — subscriptions, one-time purchases, and Stripe-hosted checkout for membership tiers and done-for-you services
Cloudflare Workers + Browser Rendering — edge-deployed worker with remote browser for site health checks
Supabase backend — auth, RLS-protected tables (leads, ai_fin_audits, ai_fin_handoffs, ai_fin_follow_ups, ai_fin_onboarding, users, agents)
publicApiSurface: checkLaunchReadiness({ launchDate, productBrief, constraints, assets, tasks })
PRICING constants (free, bronze, wave, tsunami, enterprise)
